description: This file defines a LogFragment class for Android that creates a UI fragment containing a custom LogView to display logs. It handles view inflation, layout setup, and manages scrolling behavior when new log data is added.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that manages a LogView inside a ScrollView to display log messages. It initializes the view hierarchy, configures the log view appearance, and ensures the view scrolls to show the latest logs.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, sets layout parameters, padding, text appearance, and returns the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets a TextWatcher to auto-scroll to the bottom when log text changes, and returns the resulting view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used by the fragment.
